title: pkg_deb splits on `-` character breaking control file

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
How to re-produce:
1. Remove this line from the bazel debian build: https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/master/scripts/packages/BUILD#L171
2. Rebuild debian pacakges: `bazel build --embed_label=0.1.2 --stamp //scripts/packages/...`
3. Try to install the debian package. You should get the following error:

```
dpkg: error processing archive bazel-debian.deb (--install):
 parsing file '/var/lib/dpkg/tmp.ci/control' near line 7 package 'bazel':
 `Depends' field, syntax error after reference to package `bash-'
Errors were encountered while processing:
 bazel-debian.deb
```

If we look at the control file it looks like:

```
Package: bazel
Version: 0.1.2
Section: contrib/devel
Priority: optional
Architecture: amd64
Depends: openjdk-8-jdk, pkg-config, zip, g++, zlib1g-dev, unzip, bash-
 completion
Maintainer: The Bazel Authors <bazel-dev@googlegroups.com>
Description: Bazel is a tool that automates software builds and tests.
 Supported build tasks include running compilers and linkers to produce
 executable programs and libraries, and assembling deployable packages
 for Android, iOS and other target environments. Bazel is similar to
 other tools like Make, Ant, Gradle, Buck, Pants and Maven.
Homepage: http://bazel.io
Built-Using: bazel (0.1.1)
```

As you can see the bash-completion dependency has been split between two lines which is invalid syntax. It just so happens that with both of the openjdk-8-jdk and openjdk-8-source dependencies in the depends list it is long enough to split on the next word which does not have a `-` in it. Running the build off master the control file looks like:

```
Package: bazel
Version: 0.1.2
Section: contrib/devel
Priority: optional
Architecture: amd64
Depends: openjdk-8-jdk, openjdk-8-source, pkg-config, zip, g++,
 zlib1g-dev, unzip, bash-completion
Maintainer: The Bazel Authors <bazel-dev@googlegroups.com>
Description: Bazel is a tool that automates software builds and tests.
 Supported build tasks include running compilers and linkers to produce
 executable programs and libraries, and assembling deployable packages
 for Android, iOS and other target environments. Bazel is similar to
 other tools like Make, Ant, Gradle, Buck, Pants and Maven.
Homepage: http://bazel.io
Built-Using: bazel (0.1.1)
```
